name: Brookfield Place — Winter Garden
label: FREE · ATRIUM (POPS)

name: The Malin — Flatiron

name: Conwell Coffee Hall

name: Industrious — Union Square on Broadway

name: WeWork — 18 W 18th St
label: DAY PASS · $49

name: Devoción — Williamsburg

name: The Farm SoHo
label: DAY PASS · FROM $29

name: Mindspace — Williamsburg

name: Soho Works — 875 Washington

name: Bibliotheque

name: Remi Flowers & Coffee (43rd St)
label: CAFÉ · LAPTOP-OK
